response.sql: WITH mt AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bpm FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM mt), kept AS (SELECT mt.avg_price, mt.bpm, cross_avg.avg_bpm FROM mt CROSS JOIN cross_avg WHERE mt.bpm > cross_avg.avg_bpm) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_prices, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(bpm - avg_bpm) AS avg_rate_above_cross_avg FROM kept;
